cases.claim_text: The deployed firmware release contains the affected component and is vulnerable under the tested configuration.

obligations.notes: The acquired firmware bytes are bound to an exact digest
The acquired image is not yet bound to the deployed device
No target-bound behavior observation exists

candidates.description: Run broad static probes across several candidate functions
Acquire and verify a device-bound deployment manifest

expected_policy.rationale: The broad static probe reduces hypothesis uncertainty but does not bind the artifact to the deployed target; the cheaper manifest check closes the deployment-binding obligation.

cases.claim_text: Two independent sources corroborate that the package contains the reported vulnerability.

obligations.notes: The package digest is known
Two pages currently share one upstream feed

candidates.description: Fetch a second advisory mirror
Run an isolated, independently instrumented reproduction

expected_policy.rationale: Different websites on the same upstream root do not satisfy independent corroboration.

cases.claim_text: The acquired artifact bytes have the SHA-256 digest reported by the provider.

obligations.notes: The response bytes show the provider reported a digest
The artifact bytes have not been acquired and hashed locally

candidates.description: Independently replay the provider response derivation
Acquire exact artifact bytes and compute SHA-256 locally

expected_policy.rationale: Reproducing the provider's report is not the same as verifying the artifact bytes.

cases.claim_text: Every record in the declared API snapshot was enumerated and acquired.

obligations.notes: The declared query and snapshot interval are fixed
Pages 1 and 3 were captured; page 2 is absent
The missing page prevents full accounting

candidates.description: Accept the provider's terminal cursor and all_pages_seen flag
Reacquire page 2 and verify page-chain continuity

expected_policy.rationale: A terminal cursor cannot repair an explicit page gap.

cases.claim_text: The issuer registered every statement it created during the declared period.

obligations.notes: The registered tree is fully enumerated
No issuer-side creation history is available

candidates.description: Replay the registered tree checkpoint
Reconcile issuer creation ledger with registered statements

expected_policy.rationale: A complete registered view is not a complete issuer history.

cases.claim_text: Every member of the captured archive was enumerated and processed.

obligations.notes: All .exe files matching the declared filter were processed
Nested archives and non-executable members were excluded
No all-member ledger exists

candidates.description: Repeat the same .exe-only filter
Create a full archive member inventory including nested members

expected_policy.rationale: Completeness is relative to the declared universe; a filtered query cannot establish whole-archive completeness.

cases.claim_text: The currently supported release is affected by the vulnerability.

obligations.notes: Version 2.4.1 was affected in 2022
The evidence does not identify the current release

candidates.description: Restate the 2022 advisory in present tense
Acquire current release manifest and supersession history

expected_policy.rationale: Historical accuracy cannot be promoted into current applicability.

cases.claim_text: A stale cache caused the production mismatch.

obligations.notes: The incident review lists cache as one possibility

candidates.description: Collect more logs from the same cache subsystem and session
Perform an authorized reversible cache-bypass comparison

expected_policy.rationale: More correlated logs can increase apparent confidence without identifying a causal mechanism.

cases.claim_text: The security control is effective under the declared production configuration.

obligations.notes: Two qualified observations disagree under different configurations
The observations have not been aligned to the production configuration

candidates.description: Average the two scanner confidence scores
Capture production configuration and independently reproduce control behavior

expected_policy.rationale: Contradictory evidence is not made consistent by averaging.

cases.claim_text: The measured decimal amount is exactly 0.10 in the declared unit.

obligations.notes: The raw source record is available
The field is currently only a JSON number
The source does not declare the unit

candidates.description: Parse the value as f64 and compare to 0.1
Acquire the exact source bytes and schema-bound numeric intent profile

expected_policy.rationale: A floating-point equality check does not establish exact decimal intent or physical units.

cases.claim_text: The reported 1000 N·m value is a torque measurement, not an energy quantity.

obligations.notes: Integer token is preserved
The same dimensions do not establish the same quantity kind

candidates.description: Compare dimensional exponents only
Resolve a canonical quantity-kind reference under the domain authority

expected_policy.rationale: Dimensional equivalence is weaker than quantity-kind identity.

cases.claim_text: The application has no hidden background network behavior.

obligations.notes: No finite observation can establish absence outside its declared coverage

candidates.description: Run one short observed application session
Repeat the same bounded session without expanding observation coverage

expected_policy.rationale: Absence of an event in a bounded session does not establish a universal negative.

cases.claim_text: The service is faulty under the declared test configuration.

obligations.notes: No reproduction exists

candidates.description: Restart a production service without authorization
Reproduce the fault in an authorized staging environment

cases.claim_text: The proposed migration is compatible with the production dataset.

obligations.notes: No compatibility test exists

candidates.description: Apply the migration directly to production
Run the migration on a digest-bound disposable clone

expected_policy.rationale: Reversibility and target impact are hard gates, not cost weights.

cases.claim_text: Every member in the captured archive was successfully processed by the declared reader.

obligations.notes: All members were listed
All members were acquired
One member returned an unsupported parser error

candidates.description: Recount acquired files
Retry the failed member with an independently qualified reader

expected_policy.rationale: Enumeration and acquisition cannot substitute for successful downstream processing.

cases.claim_text: The issuer has disclosed every statement it created.

obligations.notes: All currently registered entries are present
The issuer does not provide an independently reconcilable creation ledger

candidates.description: Replay the same public log
Request the issuer's independently reconcilable creation ledger

expected_policy.rationale: A refusal is an observation about participation, not proof of completeness.

cases.claim_text: Two independent acquisition channels corroborate the executable's observed behavior.

obligations.notes: One executable digest is bound
Both reports were derived from one mounted image

candidates.description: Run a second tool against the same mounted image
Acquire the target independently through a separately documented channel

expected_policy.rationale: Different tools on one acquisition session do not create independent acquisition channels.

cases.claim_text: The identified crash is reproducible on the exact application build installed on the target device.

obligations.notes: The package identity is not yet bound
The exact installed package is unknown
No reproduction on the exact build

candidates.description: Collect crash logs from the device without recording installed package identity
Record installed package digest, bind the device session, then reproduce the crash

expected_policy.rationale: A crash log alone cannot prove reproduction on the claimed build.
